data.gender_notes: Isolda is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Celtic name Isolde, meaning 'Goddess of the Sea'. In Arthurian legend, Isolda was the name of the beautiful queen who famously eloped with Tristan, the knight of King Mark. Her love for Tristan was so strong that a love potion was used to ensure their union. The name Isolda carries the meaning “Goddess of the Sea” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Isolda usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of the sea and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Isolda total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
